title: Angular Coverage Governs Training-Set Selection in Face Presentation Attack Detection: reproducibility package
description:
Code and derived results to reproduce every number and figure in the paper What to Train On, Not How to Order It: Angular Coverage Governs Training-Set Selection in Face Presentation Attack Detection.

The package is self-contained for analysis: it bundles the outcomes of all 331 controlled training runs plus the pre-computed discriminant axes, so python src/reproduce_all.py regenerates the coverage-law statistics, the forgetting analysis, the pilot experiment, the taxonomy check and all paper figures without needing the datasets or a GPU. Re-training additionally requires the seven face anti-spoofing datasets, which are not redistributed; their expected directory structure is documented in docs/DATASETS.md.
